methods.domain: Already-computed signed contrast in dB; post-contrast display experiment, not a SAR noise calibration.
methods.median: Median of 3x3 or 5x5 window; output only where entire window is valid.
methods.gaussian: Normalized masked Gaussian sigma=1 pixel, truncate=3; requires >=90% valid kernel weight and valid center.
methods.support: Retain original contrast only when center exceeds +0.5 dB and >=5/9 (or 13/25) cells exceed +0.5 dB, or symmetric negative rule. Otherwise zero. Entire window must be valid. Counts include center.
methods.persistence: Normalized Gaussian at sigma1 and sigma2, truncate3. Retain sigma1 value if original, sigma1 and sigma2 have same sign and both smoothed magnitudes >=0.5 dB; otherwise zero. Both kernels >=90% valid weight, original center valid.
methods.mask: No filling original NoData. Median/support additionally erode boundaries. Zero means suppressed or neutral, not NoData.
methods.interpretation: Thresholds are exploratory, not estimated false-alarm rates. Spatially correlated input patches are not independent samples. Small debris can be suppressed; noise can survive. Both signs retained. VH electronic noise reliability unassessed.
methods.display: Fixed blue/white/red -6/0/+6 dB for all views. No new target fitting.
